English.Char_Desc_80: Offline voice typing and transcription for Windows. Your voice stays on your PC.
English.Char_Desc_250: Type with your voice in any Windows app: hold Right Alt, speak, release. Speech recognition (Whisper) runs on your PC, so it works offline. Transcribe audio and video files and export SRT/VTT subtitles. 7-day free trial, one-time purchase.
English.Char_Desc_450: RocketWhisper turns your voice into text in any Windows app. Hold Right Alt, speak, and release: the text is typed where your cursor is. Speech recognition uses the Whisper model on your PC, so your voice never leaves your computer and it works offline. Transcribe audio and video files, export SRT/VTT subtitles, add custom vocabulary, and optionally polish the text with AI using your own API key. 7-day free trial, one-time purchase.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
RocketWhisper is a voice typing and transcription app for Windows. Speech recognition runs on your own PC with the Whisper model, so your voice never leaves your computer and it works without an internet connection.
Voice typing in any app: - Hold Right Alt, speak, and release: the text is typed where your cursor is (Word, email, Teams, your browser and any other app where you can type) - Double-tap Right Alt to keep recording hands-free - Automatic punctuation, line breaks, voice commands, correction rules and a custom vocabulary for names and terms
Transcription: - Transcribe audio files (WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A, WMA) and video files (MP4, MKV, AVI, MOV, WebM, WMV, FLV) - Batch processing for many files at once - SRT/VTT subtitle export for video creators - Voice activity detection skips silence to prevent made-up text
Optional AI processing: - Polish, summarize or translate the recognized text with your own API key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Groq) or with a local LLM (LM Studio, Ollama) - AI Command: select text, press Ctrl+Space and say what to do with it - Only when you turn AI processing on is the recognized text sent to the AI service you choose. With a local LLM, everything stays on your PC
Speed: - GPU acceleration with Vulkan on NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs; runs on the CPU when there is no GPU - NVIDIA CUDA acceleration is available when the CUDA runtime is installed
Languages: Japanese, English, Chinese and Korean, or automatic detection. The app's screens are in English and Japanese.
What it does not do: it does not click or scroll for you (use Windows Voice access for that), and text appears after you finish speaking rather than word by word.
Pricing: free 7-day trial with all features. Personal license $39.99, Business license $299.99 (unlimited PCs). One-time purchase, no subscription.
